subject: Re: Renewal – SOC2 retention horizon & evidence handoff options
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmefinancial.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.menon@acmefinancial.com>, security@acmefinancial.com
Date: 2026-09-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal question: SOC2 retention horizon and evidence handoff

Kimberly,

We're getting close to our contract renewal (Oct 31). Our InfoSec team has asked whether Redwood can extend the audit log retention from 365 days to 730 days for the next 12‑month term and provide a one‑time bulk export of the last 24 months of logs to our secure S3 bucket for our SOC 2 recertification. They also want an option for a short burst of read throughput during evidence collection (we expect ~1.2TB of compressed logs).

A few questions from our side:
- Can retention be extended to 730d at the account level for the coming term, and can that be rolled back afterward?
- What does the bulk export process look like (format, lead time, security controls)?
- Is there a charge for the export and the temporary throughput burst?

We had a pricing discussion last quarter but didn't finalize this. Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of Security Operations
Acme Financial
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal question: SOC2 retention horizon and evidence handoff

Sanjay — thanks for the clarity. Short answer: yes, we can support both the 730‑day retention window and a one‑time bulk export plus a temporary throughput increase. 

High‑level options we recommend (so you can pick what aligns with Acme's audit controls):
1) Term amendment (preferred) — extend account retention to 730d for the 12‑month renewal term; include a one‑time bulk export (24 months) and a defined throughput burst for evidence collection. This keeps retention changes scoped to the renewal and reversible at the end of term.
2) Temporary retention carveout — apply 730d to an evidence staging namespace for 90 days for export, leaving primary prod retention unchanged. Useful if you want minimal production impact.
3) Export + escrow — we can export encrypted logs to your S3 bucket and optionally seed a read‑only evidence escrow for the auditor to pull from (costs vary).

I'll loop in cost and runbook details — cc'ing Karthik for commercial terms and Rishi for the technical export/runbook. Can we schedule a 30‑minute call tomorrow to run the options and agree on lead times?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmefinancial.com>, Asha Menon <asha.menon@acmefinancial.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T13:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal question: SOC2 retention horizon and evidence handoff

Looping on pricing/contract language. Kims — two commercial levers here:
1) Retention uplift (365 -> 730d) — bill as an annual retention uplift line item across the account. We can price based on average preserved GB across the past 6 months + delta buffer for the requested 24‑month export.
2) One‑time export & burst — separate one‑time professional services / export fee + temporary capacity charge (we model as an hourly burst with a cap).

Proposed starting figures (quick back‑of‑envelope for the call):
- Retention uplift: $0.12 per GB/month on preserved cold logs (billed monthly).
- One‑time export: $1,200 flat base + $0.02 per GB transferred.
- Throughput burst: $150/hour for the burst nodes (we estimate ~24–36 hours for 1.2TB compressed depending on parallelism).

If Acme is open to a 12‑month term commitment for the retention uplift, we can offer a 10% credit on the uplift fee and include the export as a discounted addendum.

I suggest we capture whichever option they pick as a short contract amendment (SOW appendix) and route to legal. Kimberly — can you confirm the export SLA and security controls before we finalize numbers?

— Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmefinancial.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-30T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal question: SOC2 retention horizon and evidence handoff

Thanks everyone — quick technical rundown and runbook outline so Acme can validate with your auditors: 

Export format & security:
- We will provide gzipped JSONL with per‑file SHA256 checksums. Files are encrypted in transit via TLS 1.3 and at rest with server‑side AES‑256; for export we can also perform client‑side envelope encryption if you provide a public key.
- Delivery targets: 3 business day lead time to schedule export, estimated 24–48 hours for transfer depending on parallel connections and Egress throughput.

Retention & rollback:
- Option A (term amendment): set account retention to 730d on Oct 31; change persisted for the term duration. At term end, retention will be auto‑reverted to the prior setting unless an amendment extends it.
- Option B (staging namespace): create an evidence staging namespace with 730d retention for a 90‑day window; after export, we can snapshot and delete the namespace on request.

Burst plan & sizing assumptions:
- Estimated compressed transfer: 1.2TB. With 8 parallel workers, we expect ~18–30 hours. We propose reserving burst nodes for a 48‑hour window to provide a safe buffer.
- We will provide a small test export (first 2GB) to validate decryption and schema with your security team prior to full run.

Attachments: included are the evidence manifest (redwood‑evidence‑manifest‑v2.pdf), our log export playbook (log‑export‑playbook.md), and a retention pricing matrix (retention‑pricing‑matrix.csv).

Next steps (proposed):
1) Quick 30m alignment call tomorrow 10:30am PT to pick Option A vs B and get signoff on encryption mode.
2) Karthik to capture commercial terms and prepare a short amendment draft.
3) Rishi to schedule test export; provide S3 bucket details (Acme) and IAM role for the transfer.

Kimberly — can you confirm the call? Sanjay/Asha — does 10:30am PT tomorrow work?

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
